title: Oura Daytime Stress Load by Hour
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=oura:stress
| search stress_score=*
| bin _time span=1h
| stats avg(stress_score) as avg_stress_score max(stress_score) as max_stress_score by _time hour_bucket
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Oura daytime stress load over time and breaks it out by hour bucket.
value: Hour-level stress patterns help pinpoint when work, commuting, or recovery habits are driving the load.
implementation: Send Oura daytime stress load events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1h granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Oura daytime stress load by hour bucket.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how Oura daytime stress load changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
